test_overview: Evaluated the Slack-like Team Workspace app (Flask + single-page HTML/JS on port 8000) against the user-created-channels test plan. Steps 1, 2, 3, and 5 passed fully. Step 4 failed on a non-fatal sub-verification (duplicate channel was correctly rejected, but NO 'already exists' error message was displayed to the user). Step 6 failed FATALLY: clicking 'Invite to channel' opened the 'Invite to #engineering' interface, but the invitable-user selection list never loaded (stuck on 'Loading...' for 10+ seconds), so Bob was never selectable and could not be invited. Because a fatal verification failed, the entire test plan fails and all subsequent steps (7 and 8) were not performed. Additionally, a message-rendering anomaly was observed: Alice's single message in #engineering rendered ~39 duplicated copies. Final score: 31/67.

steps.description: test_initial_channel_list_shows_only_general: PASSED. Alice logged in, lands on #general, channel navigation sidebar present listing only #general (fresh state). All fatal and non-fatal verifications passed.

test_channel_creation_validation: PASSED. Empty name rejected with 'Channel name is required.' (not navigated, list unchanged). Invalid chars 'test channel' rejected with 'Channel name can only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens.' All fatal and non-fatal verifications passed.

test_create_valid_channel: PASSED. Channel 'engineering' created successfully; '# engineering' appeared in Alice's nav; app navigated to it (title '# engineering'); empty-history placeholder shown (non-fatal); sent message 'First message in engineering channel' appeared in history (non-fatal).

test_duplicate_channel_name_rejected: FAILED (0 pts, non-fatal sub-verification failed, evaluation continued). Duplicate 'engineering' was NOT created (modal stayed open, only one engineering in nav, Alice stayed on #engineering — fatal 'creation rejected' passed). However, NO error message was displayed in the modal even after ~8s (non-fatal 'error indicates channel with this name already exists' FAILED), so the step scores 0.
test_non_member_cannot_see_channel: PASSED. Bob logged in, lands on #general, has a channel navigation area listing only #general; 'engineering' is NOT visible (he's not a member).

test_invite_user_to_channel: FAILED (0 pts, FATAL — evaluation stopped). Alice navigated to #engineering and clicked 'Invite to channel'; the 'Invite to #engineering' interface appeared but the invitable-user selection list never loaded (stuck at 'Loading...' for 10+ seconds). The required user-selection interface never appeared and Bob was never available/selectable (fatal verification failed), so Bob could not be invited. Per fatal-failure rule, the entire test plan fails and steps 7-8 were not performed.
test_channel_messaging_isolated: NOT PERFORMED (0 pts) — evaluation stopped after fatal failure in step 6.
test_new_channel_hidden_from_non_members: NOT PERFORMED (0 pts) — evaluation stopped after fatal failure in step 6.
